metadata.title: Glamour Portrait with Warm Gradient and Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-glamour, tight-crop portrait featuring a warm copper-to-dark-blue gradient background and a sophisticated mix of bold serif and script typography.
excludeWhen: minimalist high-key white backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, three-quarter view portrait of a woman looking over her shoulder directly at the camera. The lighting is soft and warm, emphasizing smooth skin textures and metallic makeup. The background is a soft vertical gradient transitioning from a warm peach/copper at the top to a deep navy blue at the bottom left, providing a high-contrast anchor for the typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze creates a direct connection with the viewer
Shoulder line leads the eye upward toward the face
Typography is anchored in the dark negative space of the bottom-left corner
Warm skin tones harmonize with the copper background gradient

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale headshot occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the crown and shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one closest to the center, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, follows the shoulder line, and rests on the typography in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the bottom-left quadrant, utilizing a dark gradient to make text legible.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm copper and peach tones in the skin and upper background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue in the bottom-left corner.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sparkle from a diamond earring and glossy lip highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the skin tones against a medium-to-low value background gradient.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif and elegant cursive script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses high-contrast serifs with sharp terminals
Secondary text uses a fluid, connected script with decorative flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a structured, authoritative serif and a delicate, personal script.

preserve: All-caps serif for the main name
avoid: Centering the text over the face

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classical, high-contrast serif look of the primary name.
Provides the elegant, flowing cursive needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tight-crop studio portrait of a woman looking over her shoulder. Use warm, copper-toned lighting on the face and a background gradient that transitions from peach at the top to deep navy blue in the bottom-left corner. Ensure the bottom-left area is dark and relatively empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a white, all-caps high-contrast serif font in the bottom-left corner. Directly underneath, add the secondary title in a smaller, white elegant script font.

verificationChecks: Is the gaze directed at the camera?
Is the background gradient smooth and transitioning from warm to cool?
Is the text placed in the dark negative space for legibility?

adjustableVariables: Depth of the navy blue gradient
Tracking width of the serif text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shoulder provides a leading line
Verify the color balance between warm skin and cool background
Confirm typography is legible and correctly paired
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-fashion over-the-shoulder portrait with a dual-tone warm/cool gradient background and a serif/script typographic lockup in the lower-left quadrant.
